recommendation: Keep the commit as the FHIR-45986 source reconciliation. Revisit the ValueSet operation definitions separately if FHIR-51089 or a later ticket reaches Applied/Published and authorizes manifestParameters or wider manifest targets.
issue_request: FHIR-45986 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 vocab change request to add a manifest input parameter to ValueSet/$expand as defined by the CRMI ValueSet/$expand operation extension.
initial_application: Commit 4cd9f00b61 added manifest 0..1 canonical(Library) to ValueSet/$expand and duplicated the same manifest text into ValueSet/$validate-code as part of a multi-issue ValueSet operation-parameter update. Later commits f628812336 and ef21d8ddf3 refined that CRMI reference text and changed it to CRMI STU1 permanent URLs, but left a malformed Markdown link and the phrase "an library".
additional_context: ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini and source/valueset/list-ValueSet-operations.xml includes both ValueSet operation definitions. CRMI STU1 describes the manifest Library cqf-expansionParameters extension and expansion-rules behavior. FHIR-32642 is the older broad manifest/expansion/includeDraft ticket that led to FHIR-45986 but remains Triaged, and FHIR-51089 later proposes manifestParameters plus ImplementationGuide support but is also Triaged/in-progress.
reconciliation: Updated the manifest parameter documentation in source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-expand.xml, and repaired the same duplicated text in source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-validate-code.xml, to use "manifest Library", name cqf-expansionParameters, and fix the CRMI Markdown links. No manifestParameters, includeDraft, or ImplementationGuide target changes were made because those belong to later in-progress Jira work rather than this Applied seed.

source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-validate-code.xml: kept the duplicate manifest parameter text consistent with ValueSet/$expand because the original FHIR-45986 application changed both operation definitions.
